_comment: Synthetic example — every id carries a rationale, because six months from now the rationale is the only record of why the surface is guarded.

critical_files.rationale: deployed stale once; only byte comparison caught it

caller_transactional_modules.rationale: receives the caller's transaction; an internal commit makes rollback tests attest a guarantee the code does not give

paired_entrypoints.rationale: the retry path is exercised exactly when the primary failed; it must not bypass the migration the primary received

authoritative_writers.rationale: single-writer surface; a second writer is usually added by someone who did not find the first
